skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the role, characteristics, and structure of agricultural investment projects.
Conduct market research and identify opportunities for agricultural business investments.
Select appropriate business models and technologies for agricultural projects.
Estimate total investment capital and analyze the effectiveness of agricultural business investments.
Manage project risks and prevent risks in agricultural business investments.
Apply knowledge and develop problem-solving skills for planning and implementing agricultural projects.
Work independently and take personal responsibility.
Have social responsibility, follow laws, have organizational discipline awareness, be proactive, enthusiastic, and cooperative with work.
Have the ability to learn independently, accumulate experience to improve professional expertise.
